relevance_note: Six-patient Blau syndrome/early-onset sarcoidosis case series with per-patient NOD2 variants: "The NOD2 mutations detected were P268S (rs2066842, exon 4) and V955I (rs5743291, exon 9)."
method_note: Built with a Python script in the scratch directory; every value was chosen by reading the paper, and the script only assembled rows and copied table cells (Table 1 and Table 3 cells were checked against the tables). Table 1 has patients as columns (headers 'Patient 1' ... 'Patient 6/sibling of patient 5'); its '+' cells were read as present, but '-' is not defined as absent anywhere in the legend, so '-' cells are treated as not reported unless the text states absence. Absences come from the per-patient text ('no uveitis', 'no skin lesions', 'no articular involvement') and from two group statements naming all of 'our patients' (no mediastinal lymph node or pulmonary involvement; no eye symptoms). 'None of our patients had eye symptoms ... ocular examinations were normal' was recorded only as 'eye symptoms' excluded; cataract, glaucoma and visual impairment were left not reported (normal examination as a whole). P4 'no dermatitis' was not used to exclude the composite checklist item 'granulomatous dermatitis or skin rash' (narrow vs broad); P5/P6 'no skin lesions' was used to exclude it. Father: 'did not have any complaints or clinical findings' recorded as one excluded feature; checklist left not reported. Disease labels: P1-P4 'EOS' from the group statement 'four patients ... with EOS' (the other two being the BS siblings P5/P6; ages and sexes match Table 1); P5, P6 and mother 'BS'. Variants are given as protein short forms (e.g. P268S) without 'p.'; Table 2 gives exon, rsID, 'snv', amino-acid and nucleotide letters and 'Effect'; 'snv' is not a listed variant class, so variant_type is not reported. Pathogenicity taken from each variant's own Table 2 row ('Pathogenic'; M491L 'US' = Unknown significance). Genome build GRCh37 is stated in Methods and quoted as a second span for 16:50745293. Inheritance: P5/P6 M491L inherited maternal (mother stated to carry M491L); P5 V955I inherited paternal (father stated to carry V955I). Zygosity only where 'heterozygote' is printed (P2 M513T, P3 R702W). Relatives labelled 'mother of Patient 5' and 'father of Patient 5' (the paper says 'mother/father of patients 5 and 6'). The pedigree figure text 'S-Family' was not used as a family label (figure-embedded OCR). Table 3 (literature cases treated with biologics) persons were included only when the row gives individual-level detail: rows with 'Number of patients' 1, and the enumerated '1.'/'2.' rows of Martin et al. 27 and Yasui et al. 28. Group rows (Cuesta 3, Milman 2, Otsubo 2, Rose 19, Nagakura 6) were left out as group-level. Labels 'Table 3 row k' count Markdown data rows of Table 3 from the top, continuing through 'Table 3. Continued' (the Rose et al. 4 entry spans rows 18-20; Achille is row 21). Caracseghi (row 9) prints 'Autosomal dominant' instead of a variant and Bravo-Ljubetic (row 12) prints '-', so they have no variant rows; Bravo-Ljubetic is included only by the table's context (BS/EOS treatment summary). Yasui N670K is printed only on row 7 (patient '1.') and was assigned only to that row; Martin/Yasui treatment cells may straddle the two patients' lines. Contradictions/oddities: Table 1 lists P3's mutations as 'R702W/SNP8' while the text gives only R702W heterozygote ('SNP8' not described; no row created). Limitations say 'We could not carry out genetic tests on all family members except for the sibling patients', yet the mother and father are reported with NOD2 variants. P1 age of diagnosis is 1 year in Table 1 while he was referred at four years. P1 text says no remission with steroid, methotrexate, anakinra, adalimumab and infliximab and now on low-dose steroid and canakinumab; the Discussion says remission was achieved with the latter. The sentence 'Tuberculin skin tests were negative ... in all patients' and the 'All patients' ... normal ranges' sentence are split by tables in the Markdown, so they were not quoted (non-contiguous). MEFV variants in Table 1 (R761H, E148Q) were not recorded: the authors state 'we did not determine any significant MEFV mutations'.
